name: patient_is_consecutive_patient_referred_for_endoscopic_ultrasonography
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is a consecutive patient who has been referred for endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a consecutive patient who has been referred for endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not a consecutive patient referred for endoscopic ultrasonography.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is a consecutive patient referred for endoscopic ultrasonography.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_pregnancy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has pregnancy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has pregnancy as a clinical finding.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have pregnancy as a clinical finding.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has pregnancy as a clinical finding.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_finding_of_unwillingness_to_participate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has unwillingness to participate.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has unwillingness to participate.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have unwillingness to participate.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has unwillingness to participate.
